maxout_derivation.location: keyboard maxout is maximum UTF-16 values from one keypress
maxout_derivation.method: maximum generated direct output plus maximum state-termination fallback, measured in UTF-16 code units

name: us-altgr-intl

routing.policy: Either Option acts as AltGr when Command and Control are absent. Caps+AltGr swaps only Unicode 17 lower/upper level3/4 pairs; Caps+Shift+AltGr inverts those pairs while nonletters retain physical AltGr levels. Control emits direct ASCII C0 for US letters and direct base/physical-Shift US identity for nonletters, ignoring Caps/Option. Command has precedence, ignores Caps/Option/Control, and emits direct XKB base or physical-Shift identity. Shortcut maps contain no actions.
